Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, diagnosis_date, diagnosis_datetime, diagnosis_code, replace(upper(trim(diagnosis_code)), '.', '') as concept_code from ##duckdb_source## where upper(trim(diagnosis_code_system)) = 'OPCS4' order by diagnosis_id, warehouse_identifier

Explanation.Description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.
Clinical diagnosis date. Missing dates produce invalid condition records.
Original diagnosis code, preserved as the source value.
Uppercase, trimmed OPCS4 code with dots removed for the existing OPCS4 resolver. Only Condition-domain targets are retained.
